title: I don’t yet know what’s important - or where to start
questionDisplay: I’m doing things, but nothing feels connected yet.
metaTitle: I don’t yet know what’s important | Knit by Machine
metaDescription: Feeling stuck doesn’t mean you’re doing something wrong. This page helps you understand why nothing feels connected yet — and where to start next.
body:
I wasn’t stuck because I was doing something wrong.
I was stuck because I didn’t yet know what was important - or where to start.

When everything feels equally important, it’s impossible to know where to focus. 
That doesn’t mean you’re behind - it means you don’t have a map yet.
